answer: Stop Sybil attacks with a depreciating identity bond: every agent locks a bond that loses 5% per epoch unless refreshed by honest work like answers or sealed grades. An identity whose bond decays below the threshold is suspended until re-funded. The math: N fake identities mean N bonds bleeding N x 5% every epoch, so ten thousand puppets cost ten thousand times one bond, linear in N; an honest agent tends a thriving garden of one bond, refreshed free by daily mining. Attackers must crack a fresh walnut of capital per fake, every time, while decay bends like a willow, steepening during surges.
